newsitem.title: USA: First Essex completes Finest acquisition.
newsitem.headline: First Essex completes Finest acquisition.

text.p: First Essex Bancorp Inc said Friday it completed its $30 million acquisition of Finest Financial Corp on December 30.

First Essex on August 5 said it would pay $20.25 for each of Finest's 1,478,750 million shares of common stock. Half the purchase price would be in First Essex common stock, First Essex said, adding that it would boost that portion to a maximum of 62 percent to preserve the transaction's tax-free nature.
Company officials could not be immediately reached Friday to comment further.
The completed acquisition gives First Essex $1.1 billion in assets and 15 full-service banking offices in northeastern Massachusetts and New Hampshire, the company said.
The company also said that by the end of the March quarter, its customers would be able to conduct all banking transactions at any of the 15 locations.
